_comment: Regex sources (no flags here — the loader always compiles with 'm' added, per the requirement that every ^-anchored pattern must match per-line, not just buffer-start). Priority when multiple match: error > waiting_input > done > working. Do not add persistent TUI chrome here (e.g. a status bar segment like 'profile:' that renders on every frame regardless of state) — it will always match and starve lower-priority states of a chance to win, and it never signals a real transition.
